summary.scope: Full default Windows native all-target run after saved-plan identity, complete captured delta, exact review and warning replay across approval/application/verification/recovery, with scoped inherited deadline policy. Separate actual OS/TLS CLI gates, Python contracts and mandatory TypeScript checks remain nonadditive. This is an owned Windows development validation; host-gated ignored cases, broader STATUS/R1-R9 behavior, platform/live upstream certification and release remain open. Plan fault injection assumes access to owned saved state; it does not demonstrate an untrusted-repository or cross-principal exploit.

findings: Five actual owned RED tests reproduced acceptance of altered saved application/recovery bytes, cleared test warnings, modified review text and changed saved identity under prior host prerequisites. The condition is saved-state modification or corruption, not a demonstrated untrusted-repository, cross-principal or remote exploit. Prerequisite verification rows are explicit fixtures and do not assert compiler execution.

Common admission preserves released analyzer8/9 plan IDs and serialization while replaying the key, legacy tuple hash, fixed TTL, workspace, derived snapshot identity, original omissions, complete sorted file delta, modes and independently checked source scopes/bytes. Reconstructed exact UTF8/CRLF unified diff and test-path warnings must match the saved review before approval, new application, syntax/host/container verification or recovery. Historical idempotent receipt reads and recovery expiry semantics remain separate.

Strict duplicate/unknown JSON admission, the existing 100,000-file native ceiling, bounded saved rows/changed files, distinct selected source admission and final diff size refuse without substituting empty complete results. Matching exact serialized preparation limits admit before derived result publication; earlier CAS writes retain existing semantics. Read transactions, caller SQL policies and existing host cancellation/deadline ceilings are preserved; approval publication remains inside the effective request policy. Cooperative checks are not a hard OS scheduler or memory quota.

Thirteen actual integration cases plus two library capacity cases (included in whole-native totals) cover the original REDs plus valid legacy round trips, Unicode/CRLF bytes, ordinary apply/recovery, malformed and oversized saved JSON, corrupted manifest metadata and omitted complete delta, caller transaction/SQL restoration, both cancellation owners, zero deadline, historical expiry and refusal before an owned verifier starts. Separate CLI cases on the identical final executable exercise real approval, execution, application, corruption refusal, idempotent historical receipt and conditional recovery with exclusively owned fixtures.

The full two-thread default run records 2,426 passed / 28 failed / 39 ignored across 267 groups, with every target executed and 654 frozen inputs unchanged. Ten failures remain actual OS1314 symlink setup; 18 are Windows error32 ancestor sharing refusals in two host-install targets. Both complete targets pass 20 cases in a separate serial replay of identical executable bytes under the same default TEMP/TMP, deadlines and assertions. The original failures remain; replay counts are nonadditive and no specific external lock owner or concurrency causality is certified.

A post-freeze CI control update serializes Windows test fixtures while keeping Unix test threads 2 and all in-test concurrency adversaries. YAML syntax is parsed with the existing pinned native yaml-rust2 dependency, without installing a package. This workflow was not itself executed by the preserved whole run; fresh remote CI remains required. The current whole-run result is not relabeled successful. Actual OS1314 symlink prerequisites are not replaced by junctions or marked passed; separate real OS-credential/TLS CLI gates remain nonadditive. Directory moves, default-safe file usage proof, propagated deletion, broader STATUS/R1-R9 behavior, upstream/platform certification, main merge and release remain open.
